The '''Kaensada''' are hill tribes in [[Seanchan]] taken over by the Seanchan 300 years ago.

==Customs and appearance==
People of the Kaensada tribes live in hill forts and are considered less than civilized. Most of the tribespeople avoid the other residents of Seanchan.<ref name=comp>[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Kaensada Hills.</ref> [[Ajimbura]] is from the Kaensada.{{ref/book|10|4}} Ajimbura's tribe is forbidden to eat lizards; the reason for this is unknown. Kaensada people also ususally have dark red hair.

The hill tribes wear long braids which they take as trophies  in their endless feuds.{{ref/book|11|36}}

Each tribe has its own customs and taboos, the latter of which often makes no sense to anyone outside the tribe.<ref name="comp"/>
